# Golden corpus for the Results size gate (WK-6, architecture §19.8).
# Real-shaped torrents with invented names: the mix of single-file videos,
# seasons, albums, software, packs and one large dataset a DHT crawl sees.
#
#   s <piece KiB> <bytes> <name>      a single-file torrent
#   m <piece KiB> <name>              a multi-file torrent; its files follow:
#   f <bytes> <path>                  one file (segments split on "/")
#   r <count> <bytes> <pattern>       <count> files, {n} = 01, 02, ...
#
# Change it only with the size figures in docs/decisions/2026-11-06-WK-6.md.
